claims.summary: The dialogue runtime uses a non-semantic exact-marker scanner and finite grammatical reference classifier based on declared delimiters and relation words.
claims.disposition: Verified from the complete current 1,048-line source, whose SHA exactly matches the report-bound source.

claims.summary: Complex punctuation, repeated spaces, or nonstandard whitespace may cause first_word_after to miss or falsely detect an otherwise present relation.
claims.disposition: The proposed separator mechanism is absent. Unicode alphanumeric/underscore splitting and first-nonempty selection skip arbitrary separator runs; the relation still must be one exact finite word. Existing punctuation, newline, and Unicode-whitespace regressions pass.

claims.summary: A marker followed by represents across a dash should retain following_exact_relation syntax.
claims.disposition: Implemented as a literal isolated regression using <end_of_turn> - represents. A bracketed first draft correctly classified grouped syntax, so the final test isolates the requested later-relation path rather than introducing double counting.

claims.summary: Nested bracket references should report delimiter depth correctly against MAX_EXACT_REFERENCE_DELIMITER_DEPTH.
claims.disposition: Verified existing and exact duplicate. Current regressions prove two, three, and four levels and preserve a marker inside a deeper stack while capping the evidence receipt at four.
